NTM adds its own set of keybinds. All of them can be changed in §6Options - Controls§r under the §6Hbm's Nuclear Tech§r category.

§lGeneral§r
- §eF1§r - open the §6Quick Manual§r page of the item under your cursor. Hundreds of machines, fluids, materials and weapons have one.
- §eN§r - open the built-in calculator.
- §eV§r - toggle the armor HUD and helmet overlays.
- §eZ§r - toggle the magnet of armor that has one.
- §eC§r - toggle a jetpack or other back-mounted gear.

§lMovement§r
- §eLeft Shift§r - dash, for armor sets and items that allow it.
- §eLeft Ctrl§r - ground slam with power armor that supports hard landing.

§lTools and guns§r
- §eRight click§r cycles tool abilities, §eLeft Alt§r opens the ability menu.
- §eR§r - reload. §eLeft click§r, §eright click§r and §emiddle click§r are the primary fire, secondary fire and sights of a gun.
- §eLeft Alt§r / §eLeft Ctrl§r with the §6Settings Tool§r switch what gets pasted and paste onto whole pipe lines.

§lMachines§r
- §eArrow keys§r move the §3RBMK crane§r, §eEnter§r loads and unloads it.
- §eR§r opens the inventory of a train car you are riding.
